rationale: Builds on the current staged reverse-tail best by changing only the final export-aligned averaging path. The EMA now samples tensors only immediately after exact int8/float-kept roundtrips, with a lower decay so the short quant-aware endgame still contributes, and it records a final pre-save roundtrip sample if the stop step is not aligned. This targets final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact directly while preserving the recurrent-tail architecture, validation path, wallclock cap, and artifact format.
title: Roundtrip-Anchored Tail EMA
